text:
mara: Hey team — kicking off Apex marketplace listing onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure. Goal: initial staging + legal signoff in 4 weeks. Who can own the publisher creds and the SKU packaging?

samir: I can take publisher creds for AWS and Azure. Need a runbook for service principal + role mapping.

leigh: I'll own GCP publisher access. Quick question — do we need separate SKUs per region or one unified SKU with region pricing?

oliver: Recommend single SKU per product tier, region pricing handled by the provider listing. Keeps telemetry simpler. :+1:

sarah-legal: FYI from Legal: we need updated DPA + export control checklist before public listing. Also want to review trial terms. I'll prep redlines but need the product trial length and data retention details.

mara: Thanks. Trial = 14 days, no credit card for initial trials. Data retention: 30d logs, customer-managed data not persisted by default. Sarah, I'll DM the draft retention text.

samir: For creds: plan is to create dedicated publisher accounts and rotate keys via our KMS. Can we get approval for cross-account IAM roles?

leigh: GCP needs a publisher IAM role + a service account with domain-wide delegation for listing automation. I'll post the exact roles later.

devops-bot: Deploy job 4821 succeeded for `marketplace-listing-prep` branch at 2024-10-13T17:28:00Z

mara: Here's the artifact checklist I'm proposing — please react with ✅ if ok or suggest edits: 
```
- Packaging artifacts: 1) product icon (1024x1024 PNG) 2) screenshots (3 max) 3) short description (<= 400 chars) 4) long description + technical requirements 5) trial & pricing matrix doc 6) Terraform publisher module (example) 7) billing SKU mapping CSV
- Legal artifacts: DPA, EULA, privacy policy, SOC attestation (if available)
- Access: publisher account, billing owner, technical contact, support contact
```

oliver: ✅ on artifacts. For the Terraform module, can we reuse the templates in `infra/marketplace-pub`? If yes, I'll update with Apex-specific variables.

samir: Question on billing SKU mapping CSV format — do we have a preferred template?

mara: Use the standard columns: sku_id, sku_name, tier, unit_price_usd, billing_unit, provider_product_id. I'll attach an example in a follow-up.

sarah-legal: Also adding: need clear export control labeling if any ML features use restricted data sets. Are we exposing any pretrained models that require special notices?

mara: Apex uses open-license models only, nothing restricted. Will confirm model list by EOD.

leigh: Ops ask — what's our fallback plan if marketplace validation fails? We should have a private listing link or direct-quoting page ready.

oliver: We can publish a private marketplace offer while we iterate. That gives customers a way to access early builds.

mara: Action items so far: 
- samir: create AWS/Azure publisher accounts + runbook for role setup (due in 3 days)
- leigh: GCP service account + roles doc (due in 3 days)
- sarah-legal: draft DPA redlines + trial terms review (due in 5 days)
- oliver: fork Terraform module and update artifacts (due in 4 days)
- mara: attach SKU mapping CSV example and model list (due EOD)

samir: noted. I'll also schedule a 30m sync with billing ops to validate pricing tiers.

leigh: I'll post the `roles.yaml` snippet after lunch.

sarah-legal: FYI I'll need the long description + telemetry opt-in language to check privacy impact.

mara: Understood. I'll attach draft long description shortly.

oliver: small nit — product icon needs transparent background? marketplace UX sometimes prefers rounded icons. I'll export both PNG and SVG.

mara: Good call. Add both to the artifact list.

samir: tagging @billing-ops for visibility @billing-ops please confirm any constraints on per-seat vs per-usage pricing for Azure marketplace.

devops-bot: Reminder: marketplace schema validator cron ran — 2 warnings in `marketing/long-description` (line length); see CI job 4830.

mara: I'll fix the copy to pass validator.

leigh: Quick dependency: we need a test tenant in each cloud to validate SSO and onboarding flow. Who can provision?

oliver: I can provision AWS + Azure test tenants. Leigh can handle GCP?

leigh: Yep will provision GCP test tenant tonight.

mara: Great. Let's reconvene for a short status sync on Friday 11am PT. If anyone can't make it, post updates in this thread.

sarah-legal: I'll be there.

samir: same.

oliver: same.

mara: Thanks all — moving this to a pinned thread. :rocket:
